projects.name: DOOM
projects.description: Playable DOOM running on the H743 with a real 730 KB multi-bank heap. Build, change the C sources, and flash the result.

projects.name: Blinky
projects.description: The board's PC13 LED blinks every 500 ms and reports the count over USART1.

projects.name: Button controlled LED
projects.description: Read the active-low PE4 button, toggle the PC13 LED on each press, and log the event to USART1.

projects.name: UART echo
projects.description: Echo bytes received on USART1 at 115200 baud. Open the IDE serial monitor and type a line.

projects.name: Timer and heartbeat
projects.description: Use the board millisecond timer without blocking; pulse PC13 and report uptime once per second.

projects.name: FreeRTOS tasks
projects.description: Run preemptive LED and serial-monitor tasks with upstream FreeRTOS 11.1.0 on the H743.

projects.name: LCD color cycle
projects.description: Initialize the ILI9341 SPI display and cycle through RGB565 color bars using the H743 board driver.
